title: Settlement Point Entity Directory (settlements/<id>/data.json)
description: Schema for Settlement Points per the Project Halcyon design doc. Each Sub-Faction holds 1-3 named settlements. Each settlement contributes to its parent Sub-Faction's State Vector (loss directly modifies Martial Power, Defensive Posture, Reach). Settlements can be captured, sacked, burned, abandoned. Influence Zones radiate from settlements; overlaps form Contested Zones.

display_name.description: Settlement name (e.g., 'Pinewolf Hold', 'Tarrick's Crown', 'Black Iris Quay'). Lore-bearing; the design doc uses these names directly in faction descriptions.

sub_faction.description: Required. Parent Sub-Faction this settlement belongs to. Settlement state contributes to the Sub-Faction's State Vector roll-up.

settlement_type.description: Settlement classification. capital: the Sub-Faction's seat (1 per Sub-Faction max). town: standard population center. hold: Karnish-style clan stronghold. ritual_site: Sethrai pyramid or temple. trade_post: economic hub. fortress: military strongpoint. ruined: post-collapse remnant (becomes a Ruin per the design doc).

tile_assignment.description: Where on the hex tile graph this settlement is placed.

population_capacity.description: Abstract population this settlement supports. Contributes to Sub-Faction Reach calculations.

influence_radius_tiles.description: Base Influence Zone radius from this settlement in hex tiles. Multiplied by parent Sub-Faction's Reach at runtime to determine effective influence area.

settlement_state_contributions.description: What this settlement contributes to its parent Sub-Faction's State Vector. The Sub-Faction's State Vector is the sum/aggregate of its settlements' contributions. Loss of this settlement subtracts these contributions.

named_npcs.description: Authored named NPC URNs that inhabit this settlement at world start.

ruined_state.description: Optional. Present when settlement_type is 'ruined' (a pre-existing Ruin from a dead Sub-Faction's old settlement). Contains loot tables, void-touched haunting probability, and the former leader's name preserved in the ruin's display.

former_sub_faction.description: URN of the dead Sub-Faction this settlement used to belong to.

haunting_chance.description: Probability that the ruin is Void-Touched-haunted (per the Sundering thesis that Sub-Faction collapse creates Interference residue).

scene.description: Optional scene URN for the settlement's in-world representation.
